MakeItSo.name: Make It So
MakeItSo.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Every {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:Skill|Skills} you play in a turn, put this into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
MakeItSo.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
你每在一回合内打出{Cards:diff()}张技能牌，就将这张牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

Malaise.name: Malaise
Malaise.text_zh: 敌人失去X{IfUpgraded:show:+1}点[gold]力量[/gold]。给予X{IfUpgraded:show:+1}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。

Mangle.name: Mangle
Mangle.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Enemy loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
Mangle.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
敌人在本回合失去{StrengthLoss:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。

ManifestAuthority.name: Manifest Authority
ManifestAuthority.text:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Add 1 random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]} Colorless card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ManifestAuthority.text_zh:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
将一张随机{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]升级过的[/gold]}无色牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

MasterPlanner.name: Master Planner
MasterPlanner.text: When you play a Skill, it gains [gold]Sly[/gold].
MasterPlanner.text_zh: 当你打出技能牌时，该牌获得[gold]奇巧[/gold]。

Maul.name: Maul
Maul.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Increase the damage of ALL Maul cards by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
Maul.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害两次。
在这场战斗中，将所有“撕咬”牌的伤害增加{Increase:diff()}。

Mayhem.name: Mayhem
Mayhem.text: At the start of your turn, play the top card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Mayhem.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，打出你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]顶部的牌。

Melancholy.name: Melancholy
Melancholy.text:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Reduce this card's cost by {Energy:energyIcons()} whenever ANYONE dies.
Melancholy.text_zh:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
每当有任何生物死亡时，这张牌的耗能减少{Energy:energyIcons()}。

MementoMori.name: Memento Mori
MementoMori.text:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each card discarded this turn.
MementoMori.text_zh:
造成{CalculatedDamage:diff()}点伤害。
本回合每丢弃过一张牌，则增加{ExtraDamage:diff()}点额外伤害。

Metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
Metamorphosis.text: Add {Cards:diff()} random Attacks into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. They're free to play this combat.
Metamorphosis.text_zh: 在你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中加入{Cards:diff()}张随机攻击牌。它们在本场战斗中可以被免费打出。

MeteorShower.name: Meteor Shower
MeteorShower.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
MeteorShower.text_zh:
对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
给予所有敌人{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]和[gold]易伤[/gold]。

MeteorStrike.name: Meteor Strike
MeteorStrike.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
[gold]生成[/gold]3个[gold]等离子[/gold]充能球。

Mimic.name: Mimic
Mimic.text: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the [gold]Block[/gold] on another player.
Mimic.text_zh: 获得等同于另一位玩家[gold]格挡[/gold]值的[gold]格挡[/gold]。

MindBlast.name: Mind Blast
MindBlast.text:
Deal damage equal to the number of cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
MindBlast.text_zh:
造成你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中剩余牌数的伤害。{InCombat:
（造成{CalculatedDamage:diff()}点伤害）|}

MinionStrike.name: Minion Strike
MinionStrike.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

Mirage.name: Mirage
Mirage.text:
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to [gold]Poison[/gold] on ALL enemies.{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold])|}
Mirage.text_zh:
获得等同于所有敌人[gold]中毒[/gold]层数的[gold]格挡[/gold]。{InCombat:
（获得{CalculatedBlock:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]）|}

Misery.name: Misery
Misery.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply any debuffs on the enemy to ALL other enemies.
Misery.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
给予其他敌人该名敌人身上的所有负面效果。

Modded.name: Modded
Modded.text:
Gain {Repeat:diff()} Orb {Repeat:plural:Slot|Slots}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}. Increase this card's cost by 1.
Modded.text_zh:
获得{Repeat:diff()}个充能球栏位。
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。这张牌的耗能加1。

MoltenFist.name: Molten Fist
MoltenFist.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
将该敌人身上的[gold]易伤[/gold]层数翻倍。

MomentumStrike.name: Momentum Strike
MomentumStrike.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Reduce this card's cost to 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
MomentumStrike.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
这张牌的耗能降为0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

MonarchsGaze.name: Monarch's Gaze
MonarchsGaze.text: Whenever you attack an enemy, it loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
MonarchsGaze.text_zh: 每当你攻击敌人的时候，这名敌人在本回合失去{StrengthLoss:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。

Monologue.name: Monologue
Monologue.text: Whenever you play a card this turn, gain {Power:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
Monologue.text_zh: 每当你在本回合打出卡牌时，在本回合获得{Power:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。

Murder.name: Murder

造成{CalculatedDamage:diff()}点伤害。
你在本场战斗中每抽过一张牌，此牌就额外造成{ExtraDamage:diff()}点伤害。

NecroMastery.name: Necro Mastery
NecroMastery.text:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] loses HP,
ALL enemies lose that much HP as well.

每当[gold]奥斯提[/gold]失去生命值时，
所有敌人失去等量生命值。

NegativePulse.name: Negative Pulse

获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
给予所有敌人{DoomPower:diff()}层[gold]灾厄[/gold]。

NeowsFury.name: Neow's Fury
NeowsFury.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
将你[gold]弃牌堆[/gold]中的至多{Cards:diff()}张牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

Neurosurge.name: Neurosurge
Neurosurge.text:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
At the start of your turn, apply {NeurosurgePower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
Neurosurge.text_zh:
获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
在你的回合开始时，给予自身{NeurosurgePower:diff()}层[gold]灾厄[/gold]。

Neutralize.name: Neutralize
Neutralize.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
给予{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。

Nightmare.name: Nightmare
Nightmare.text:
Choose a card.
Next turn, add 3 copies of that card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Nightmare.text_zh:
选择一张牌。
在下个回合将这张牌的3张复制品加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

NoEscape.name: No Escape
NoEscape.text:
Apply {CalculationBase:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold], plus an additional {CalculationExtra:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] for every {DoomThreshold:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] already on this enemy.{IsTargeting:
(Apply {CalculatedDoom:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold])|}
NoEscape.text_zh:
给予{CalculationBase:diff()}层[gold]灾厄[/gold]，敌人身上每有{DoomThreshold:diff()}层[gold]灾厄[/gold]，则额外给予这名敌人{CalculationExtra:diff()}层[gold]灾厄[/gold]。{IsTargeting:
（给予{CalculatedDoom:diff()}层[gold]灾厄[/gold]）|}

Normality.name: Normality
Normality.text:
You cannot play more than 3 cards this turn.{InCombat:
({CalculatedCards:plural:{} card|{} cards} left)|}
Normality.text_zh:
你在本回合不能打出超过3张牌。{InCombat:
（还剩{CalculatedCards}张牌）|}

Nostalgia.name: Nostalgia
Nostalgia.text: The first Attack or Skill you play each turn is placed on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Nostalgia.text_zh: 每回合首次打出攻击或技能牌时，将其置于你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]顶端。

NoxiousFumes.name: Noxious Fumes
NoxiousFumes.text: At the start of your turn, apply {PoisonPerTurn:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
NoxiousFumes.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，给予所有敌人{PoisonPerTurn:diff()}层[gold]中毒[/gold]。

Null.name: Null
Null.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
给予{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。
[gold]生成[/gold]1个[gold]黑暗[/gold]充能球。

Oblivion.name: Oblivion
Oblivion.text: Whenever you play a card this turn, apply {DoomPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] to the enemy.
Oblivion.text_zh: 打出此牌后，你在本回合内每打出一张牌，就给予该敌人{DoomPower:diff()}层[gold]灾厄[/gold]。

Offering.name: Offering
Offering.text_zh:
失去{HpLoss:diff()}点生命。
获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

Omnislice.name: Omnislice
Omnislice.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Damage ALL other enemies equal to the damage dealt.
Omnislice.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
对所有其他敌人造成等量的伤害。

OneTwoPunch.name: One-Two Punch
OneTwoPunch.text: This turn, your next {Attacks:cond:>1?{Attacks:diff()} Attacks are|Attack is} played an extra time.
OneTwoPunch.text_zh: 在这个回合，你打出的下{Attacks:diff()}张攻击牌会被额外打出一次。

Outbreak.name: Outbreak
Outbreak.text: Every {Repeat:plural:time|{Repeat:diff()} times} you apply [gold]Poison[/gold], deal {OutbreakPower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Outbreak.text_zh: 每当你给予{Repeat:diff()}次[gold]中毒[/gold]，就对所有敌人造成{OutbreakPower:diff()}点伤害。

Overclock.name: Overclock
Overclock.text:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Add a [gold]Burn[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
Overclock.text_zh:
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
将一张[gold]灼伤[/gold]加入你的[gold]弃牌堆[/gold]。

PactsEnd.name: Pact's End
PactsEnd.text:
If you have {Cards:diff()} or more {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold],
deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
PactsEnd.text_zh:
如果你的[gold]消耗牌堆[/gold]拥有大于等于{Cards:diff()}张{Cards:plural:牌|牌}，
则对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。

Pagestorm.name: Pagestorm
Pagestorm.text: Whenever you draw an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Pagestorm.text_zh: 每当你抽到一张[gold]虚无[/gold]牌时, 抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

PaleBlueDot.name: Pale Blue Dot
PaleBlueDot.text: If you play {CardPlay} or more cards in a turn, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
PaleBlueDot.text_zh: 如果你在一回合内打出了大于等于{CardPlay}张牌，在下个回合开始时抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

Panache.name: Panache
Panache.text: Every time you play 5 cards in a single turn, deal {PanacheDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Panache.text_zh: 每当你在一回合内打出五张牌时，对所有敌人造成{PanacheDamage:diff()}点伤害。

PanicButton.name: Panic Button
PanicButton.text:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
You cannot gain [gold]Block[/gold] from cards for {Turns:diff()} {Turns:plural:turn|turns}.
PanicButton.text_zh:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
你在接下来的{Turns:diff()}回合内无法再从卡牌中获得[gold]格挡[/gold]。

Parry.name: Parry
Parry.text_zh: [gold]君王之剑[/gold]现在能让你获得{ParryPower:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

ParticleWall.name: Particle Wall
ParticleWall.text:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ParticleWall.text_zh:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
将此牌返回你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

Patter.name: Patter
Patter.text_zh:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
获得{VigorPower:diff()}点[gold]活力[/gold]。

PerfectedStrike.name: Perfected Strike
PerfectedStrike.text:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for ALL your cards containing “Strike”.
PerfectedStrike.text_zh:
造成{CalculatedDamage:diff()}点伤害。
你每有一张名字中含有“打击”的牌，伤害+{ExtraDamage:diff()}。

PhantomBlades.name: Phantom Blades
PhantomBlades.text:
[gold]Shivs[/gold] gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
The first [gold]Shiv[/gold] you play each turn deals {PhantomBladesPower:diff()} additional damage.
PhantomBlades.text_zh:
[gold]小刀[/gold]获得[gold]保留[/gold]。
你在每回合打出的第一张[gold]小刀[/gold]额外造成{PhantomBladesPower:diff()}点伤害。

PhotonCut.name: Photon Cut
PhotonCut.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Put 1 card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
PhotonCut.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

PiercingWail.name: Piercing Wail

Pillage.name: Pillage
Pillage.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw cards until you draw a non-Attack card.
Pillage.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
抽牌直到你抽到一张非攻击牌。

PillarOfCreation.name: Pillar of Creation
PillarOfCreation.text: Whenever you create a card, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
PillarOfCreation.text_zh: 每当你生成一张卡牌, 就获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

Pinpoint.name: Pinpoint
Pinpoint.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each Skill played this turn.
Pinpoint.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。

PoisonedStab.name: Poisoned Stab
PoisonedStab.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
给予{PoisonPower:diff()}层[gold]中毒[/gold]。

PommelStrike.name: Pommel Strike
PommelStrike.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.text:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

Pounce.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
你的下一张技能牌耗能变为0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

PreciseCut.name: Precise Cut
PreciseCut.text:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:inverseDiff()} less damage for each other card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PreciseCut.text_zh:
造成{CalculatedDamage:diff()}点伤害。
你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中每有一张牌，此牌的伤害就降低{ExtraDamage:inverseDiff()}点。

Predator.name: Predator

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Next turn, draw 2 cards.
Predator.text_zh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
在下个回合抽2张牌。

PrepTime.name: Prep Time
PrepTime.text: At the start of your turn, gain {PrepTimePower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
PrepTime.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，获得{PrepTimePower:diff()}点[gold]活力[/gold]。

PrimalForce.name: Primal Force
PrimalForce.text: Transform all Attacks in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold].

Prolong.name: Prolong

Protector.name: Protector
